name: dsh-plugin-sportsdesk-desk-panel
description: Left-sidebar SportsDesk entry in the Harness Web UI: a global panel icon with a live status dot and a desk page for the local SportsDesk webview service the desk runs with bun run serve — a live Server-Sent Events card (connection state, frames, heartbeats, counter deltas) plus service runtime, memory, Telegram mode, report schedules, market feed, book KPIs, paper execution, probe provenance and stale-build recovery; the Host half proxies an allowlist of read-only desk GET routes plus one chunked SSE route.
